name: Monolithisch India Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2018, MonolithischIndia Ltd is a manufacturer of pre mixed high-quality ramming mass[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
MIL is an ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, ISO 22301:2019, ISO 37301:2021, ISO 45001:2018, and ISO/IEC 27701:2022 certified company engaged in manufacturing and supply 
of specialized ramming mass, a heat insulation/lining material used as a refractory consumable for Induction furnaces installed in iron, steel, and foundry plants.
The company also undertakes trading activities occasionally to meet excess and urgent customer demands.

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 114% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 56.2%
cons: Stock is trading at 10.6 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
